description: Behavioural regression scenarios; run with the named skill in a project with a dev server unless the prompt says otherwise. Assertions require judging executed work, not matching skill text. Static validation does not run these scenarios.

cases.prompt: Let's tighten up the pricing page at /pricing. Wipe as we go.
assertions: Runs snap for /pricing with a note such as 'before' before making any edit to the code.
Snaps once after each pass, with a note describing the change in the user's terms.
Every snap captures /pricing (given or reused from the run) and reports each saved version label.

cases.prompt: I've already changed the header layout but haven't committed. Can you show me a before and after with Wipe?
assertions: Does not snap the current, edited state as v0 or label it 'before'.
Runs base HEAD (or another ref from before the edits), starts that worktree on a free port, and snaps it as v0 with --url pointing at it.
Stops the server it started for the base and runs clean once the worktree is no longer needed.
Snaps the current state as v1 and builds the compare page with show.

cases.prompt: Snap the dashboard at 390x844 so we can see it on mobile. (The run's earlier versions were captured at 1280x800.)
assertions: Tells the user that the new version's viewport differs from the earlier versions and that the comparison is uneven.
Does not present a comparison across the two viewports as a like-for-like result.
Offers a fix, such as snapping at the run's viewport or starting a separate run with --run.

cases.prompt: Make me a before/after video of the last three passes. (ffmpeg is not installed.)
assertions: Runs clip and reads its exit code 3.
Says plainly that no video or GIF was made because ffmpeg is missing, and gives the compare page path the command printed.
Offers to install ffmpeg and does not install it without asking.

cases.prompt: Render the clip with a receipt of the numbers so I can post it. Both versions were snapped with --measure against http://localhost:3000.
assertions: Runs clip --receipt and reports the output paths and sizes.
Says the numbers come from a localhost dev server and does not describe them as production performance.
Relays any note: the command printed about the receipt.

cases.prompt: I'm iterating on the settings screen of our iOS app in the Simulator. Keep versions with Wipe as we go.
assertions: Captures with xcrun simctl io booted screenshot (or an equivalent simulator tool) to a temporary file.
Passes that file to snap with --image and a note, instead of trying to capture a URL.
Captures the baseline before the first edit and keeps the same device and orientation for later passes.

cases.prompt: That last pass looks good. Commit the changes.
assertions: The commit contains no file under .wipe/.
Does not add .wipe/ to .gitignore or force-add it.
